'''Hara Wenfare''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived in the [[Jedi Colony]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]. She sold [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]], [[Pepper/Legends|peppered]] [[Bantha steak/Legends|bantha steak]], and a chilled [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] cocktail.<ref name="TOR" />
